value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver turns cooler, around a 65°F high, with partly sunny skies and clouds. Showers are possible late in the day, about a 30% chance after 3 p.m. that picks up into the evening. Tuesday night drops to the low 40s, some 30s. Breezy from the north-northeast, gusts up to 17 mph.
